query: Can you guide me on how to file a complaint with a BDO?
reference_answer:
Complaint against Block Development Officer (BDO):
To file a complaint against a BDO, contact the District Collector's office or the local Tahsildar office. You can also submit a written complaint to the Revenue Divisional Officer (RDO) or the District Revenue Officer (DRO).
answer: To file a complaint with BDO (Bank of the Philippines), visit their official website, fill out the online complaint form, and submit it along with any relevant documents. Alternatively, you can mail your complaint to their address or visit a branch in person. [Document 1]
